categories.label: Dental care
categories.source: NPPES NPI Registry + HRSA health center sites
categories.coverage_note: 1 mobile unit also serves this county, and is not included in these travel times — HRSA publishes only their dispatch address, not where they park. Ask the health center for the schedule. Solo and small private practices are not included — they enumerate as individuals rather than organizations, and their listed address is often a home address, so mapping them would publish private residences. The real number of practices is higher than the count here.

categories.label: Free & charitable clinics
categories.source: Clinic operators' published locations pages (greenvillefreeclinic.org, taylorsfmc.org)
categories.coverage_note: Four of the five sites open only on named days, and two gate entry on a registration window rather than closing time, so check the hours before travelling. Taylors takes new patients on Wednesdays from 9:00 to 11:30am only.

categories.label: County health department
categories.source: SC DPH public health clinic directory (dph.sc.gov)
categories.coverage_note: One county health department, at 352 Halton Road, offering family planning, immunizations, STD/HIV/Hep C, WIC, PrEP, doxyPEP, TB and opioid overdose kits. Appointments statewide: (855) 472-3432.

categories.label: WIC clinics
categories.source: SC DPH public health clinic directory (dph.sc.gov)
categories.coverage_note: All five SC DPH sites in the county offering WIC. Two open on named days only: Simpsonville on Mondays and Thursdays, Slater on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Appointments statewide: (855) 472-3432.

categories.label: Community mental health centers
categories.source: SC Dept. of Behavioral Health and Developmental Disabilities (bhdd.sc.gov)
categories.coverage_note: The three Greater Greenville Mental Health Center clinics, the public system for the county, which take Medicaid and the uninsured. Private practices are counted separately under mental health.
